task_completion.description: Open the existing enterprise_network.drawio file in the Diagrams folder.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The draw.io/diagrams.net interface is visible showing the initial topology (ISP and Border Routers).

task_completion.description: Add Core, Distribution, and Access layers using Cisco shapes with correct color-coding.
task_completion.visual_evidence: New Cisco-style switch icons are present. Colors must be: Blue (Core), Green (Distribution), and Orange (Access). Gold should be used for WAN/Border.

task_completion.description: Connect layers and label links with interface type and capacity.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Lines connecting switches have text labels indicating interface types (e.g., 'TenGigabitEthernet') and capacities (e.g., '10Gbps').

task_completion.description: Create a second page named 'OOB Management' with management devices.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A second tab at the bottom of the draw.io workspace labeled 'OOB Management' containing a console server and management switch.

task_completion.description: Connect management network to routers and core switches on the second page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Connections visible between the management switch/console server and the network infrastructure devices on the OOB Management page.

task_completion.description: Export the final multi-page diagram as a PDF to the specified directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The File > Export menu is used, or a file manager shows enterprise_network.pdf in ~/Diagrams/.

integrity.description: The agent used the draw.io GUI to build the diagram rather than just generating a file via script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the draw.io sidebar, dragging shapes, or typing in the properties panel.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific Cisco shape library as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The shape library panel on the left shows 'Cisco' categories selected, and icons match standard Cisco network symbols.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create empty boxes with labels but used actual network icons.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual presence of switch and router icons rather than generic rectangles.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The initial file enterprise_network.drawio contains 4 devices (ISP-A, ISP-B, Border-RTR-01, Border-RTR-02). The agent must add three distinct layers: Core (Blue), Distribution (Green), and Access (Orange). A second page named 'OOB Management' is mandatory. The final output must be a PDF located at /home/ga/Diagrams/enterprise_network.pdf. The user login is 'ga' with password 'password123'.
